# Notice for the exercise fixture

`sample-110.json` is a subset of the exercise data in the free-exercise-db project (yuhonas/free-exercise-db),
file dist/exercises.json at commit 79ca7b47d77cd5a6dd7a50440e9f0bf24da6a142: the 110 entries whose name
contains deadlift, rack pull, good morning, bench press or squat, with the instructions and images removed.
That project says it derives from wrkout/exercises.json, also under the Unlicense. Where the names, tags and
text originally came from was not independently verified. It is used here only as test input.
